_note: Non-combat skills shown in the Skills window (N). Add a skill by adding an entry; 'xp' lists what earns it (see Game.skill_event). Perks: {level, text, effect: {key: value per level}}. Edit from the dashboard.

skills.name: Smithing & Forging
skills.desc: Smelting ore into ingots and forging weapons and armour at the Blacksmith, upgrading gear, and breaking it down for parts.
how: Smelt or forge at the Blacksmith (Craft)

perks.text: Forged gear is more likely to come out Rare
Salvaging sometimes gives an extra material

skills.name: Crafting
skills.desc: Jewellery, enhancement stones and scrolls made at the Magic Tower.
how: Craft rings, amulets, enhancement stones and scrolls at the Magic Tower

perks.text: 1% less gold per recipe per 4 levels (up to 15%)
Crafted jewellery is more likely to come out Rare

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.desc: Brewing potions and elixirs from herbs and monster parts at the Magic Tower.
how: Brew potions and elixirs at the Magic Tower (Craft)

perks.text: 1% chance per level to brew one extra

skills.name: Enchanting & Disenchanting
skills.desc: Taking items apart at the Magic Tower to learn their magic, then laying it onto your own gear. Learned from the Enchanter's lesson.
how: Disenchant items at the Magic Tower

perks.text: More enchantments per item and higher-tier gear as you level (see the Magic Tower)

skills.name: Slayer
skills.desc: Hunting the monsters on City Hall bounties. Every bounty kill and every bounty handed in trains it.
how: Kill your City Hall bounty target
Hand in bounties (boss bounties count for much more)

perks.text: +1% damage against your bounty target per 2 levels
